# An excerpt of two board traces of gl_test case 207 msaazs (#1386) on the
# NanoPC-T6, for the frame builder's 4x depth/stencil proof
# (src/mali/frame_msaa_tests.rs): a 64x64 RGBA8 texture and a 64x64
# GL_DEPTH_STENCIL_OES texture attached with
# glFramebufferTexture2DMultisampleEXT(..., 4), a 4x tile buffer over
# single-sampled memory (EXT_multisampled_render_to_texture). Per source:
# the command-stream words of each draw and of the frame's end (to
# RUN_FRAGMENT), the sample-position buffer and the descriptor buffer
# (framebuffer parameters, ZS/CRC extension, render target, tiler context,
# each draw's depth/stencil and blend descriptors).
#
# Board: NanoPC-T6 (RK3588, Mali-G610, GPU_ID 0xa8670005), Armbian,
# Linux 6.18.55-current-rockchip64, panthor 1.5.0, Mesa 25.0.7-2+deb13u1.
# The program, 0dce654a8:tools/mali/board-ref/2026-10-20-msaa-zs/msaazs.c, by
# tools/mali/mesa-board-ref.sh (PAN_MESA_DEBUG=linear,nocrc,dump,trace,sync).
# Source "mesa-msrtt": the depth texture on DEPTH, the case's depth frame
#   (cleared black, depth 1.0, stencil 0; one draw of 12 vertices, LESS
#   with writes): "verdict case 207 msaazs: PASS".
#   mesa-msrtt.pandecode sha256 8c3f8fec51e31a44a52b977bbce3fa70850b5b5f0e734497afc03a2037c9192b
# Source "mesa-msrtts": the depth texture on STENCIL, the case's stencil
#   frame (the same clear; 3 vertices ALWAYS 1 REPLACE, then 6 vertices
#   EQUAL 0 KEEP, the depth test off): "verdict case 207 msaazs: PASS".
#   mesa-msrtts.pandecode sha256 6cac094036bba5ba85913b4785bcf6c528a3f53aab05d3ee8ca0e633415b298e
# Cut by tools/mali/board_dump_cut.py (each source's first draw and its two
# buffers), the other command-stream blocks by their line ranges.
